visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-bleed muted, looping background video with poster image and a pause/play toggle; no text
observed: Background loop video (poster image + mp4 link) with pause/play control

contentPattern.structure: row 1: poster image + link to the video file (.mp4/.webm), optional link to a .vtt description track; the video link text is the video title. Optional row 2: pause label | play label for the toggle button
notes: Embedded video with play/pause control is an interactive component an author cannot type as default content; Video block from the library takes the poster and video source.

usage: Decorative ambient campus video at the top of a page.
reuseGuidance: Use for text-free background video; for a video beside text use hero-split-video, for embeds (YouTube) use embed.
